title: REQ · Exporter includes only frozen contributions in snapshot order
summary: Exporter.Export returns only contributions whose ids are frozen
description: Exporter reads ListByRound and FrozenIDs from an ExportSource and builds Export with Version ExportVersion, WorldID, RoundID and ExportContribution entries (ID, Author=PlayerID, Content=Prompt, CreatedAt) for frozen ids only, in the order FrozenIDs lists them.
acceptance_criteria: Given contributions A,B,C and frozen ids [C,A], When Export runs, Then Contributions IDs are [C,A]
Given an unfrozen contribution B, When Export runs, Then B does not appear and fields map PlayerID to author and Prompt to content

out_of_scope: empty round handling beyond non-nil slice

technical_constraints: Frozen ids absent from ListByRound are skipped
